source: AETC hwis/aetc hooks/patientReg.ts and app/registration/components/ddePatientRegistration.tsx: two rows per person
target: MaHIS-core / EMR-API layout: one row per person

row_classification.home: row with any of address3, state_province, county_district filled (usually preferred = 1)
row_classification.current: row with only address1, address2, city_village filled (usually preferred = 0)
row_classification.tie_break: if a person has more than one row of the same kind, use the latest date_created
row_classification.ignore: rows that are voided or have every address field empty

column_map.note: AETC sends countryDistrict (typo) on the current row, so OpenMRS dropped it; home.address3 is the only copy

source_list_semantics: take the first non-null value after null_values are applied

row_fields.uuid: home row uuid (current row uuid if there is no home row)
row_fields.date_created: earliest date_created of the merged rows
row_fields.creator: users.json

id_map: record both AETC person_address_id values against the single new MaHIS person_address_id
